description: This file defines a client class for managing models via a REST API in a system called LiteLLM Proxy. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting models, with support for returning requests for debugging. It also handles authorization and error cases.

classes.name: ModelsManagementClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the LiteLLM proxy server for managing models, including operations like listing, adding, deleting, retrieving, and updating models.
